text:
maya: heads-up - sudden spike in mTLS handshake failures in eu-west at 15:03 UTC. proxies show KMS decrypt AccessDenied.
owen: saw it, rotator logs full of AccessDenied. Any RBAC changes?
sam_infra: there was a scheduled RBAC prune at 15:00. It should have been dry-run.
lee: paste (redacted):
```
2026-08-11T15:03:12Z rotator-eu-1 ERROR cert: unseal failed: kms:Decrypt AccessDenied for key arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123:key/rot-2026
    at keystore.unseal (rotator.go:176)
    at proxy/handshake (handshake.go:84)
```
maya: CloudTrail shows a Deny for kms:Decrypt from role arn:aws:iam::123:role/rotator-prod. RBAC prune removed role binding from group svc-rotator-eu.
sam_infra: pipeline env var flip caused --dry-run to be omitted. My bad.
own: mitigation?
lee: options: revert binding (fast), temp key-policy relax (touches KMS), or failover to cached certs. Revert is quickest.
maya: open revert PR and page infra-ops.
infra-bot: Revert PR submitted by owen: https://git.internal/infra/rbac/pull/622 
sam_infra: infra-ops approved at 15:07 UTC.
own: binding restored 15:07:30. rotator decrypts resumed 15:08:05. handshake failures dropped ~93% by 15:10.
maya: tagging logs with incident id inc-1768882222 and exported CloudTrail slice.
sam_infra: root cause: prune wrapper allowed a pipeline toggle; dry-run not enforced.
lee: follow-ups: 1) make dry-run default and require explicit PROD_CONFIRM to apply, 2) add pre-prune canary that runs a kms:Decrypt using the effective service principal per region and aborts if any fail, 3) maintain a keystore allowlist that prune cannot remove, 4) enhance proxy backoff so short KMS denies don't cascade.
own: monitoring rule suggestion (alert if >8% proxies see KMS AccessDenied in 2m):
```
sum(rate(kms_decrypt_denied_total{region="eu-west"}[2m])) / sum(up{job="proxy",region="eu-west"}) > 0.08
```
sam_infra: I'll pause scheduled rbac-prune until fixes are in.
soc-team: SOC notified; requested audit bundle and timeline. No evidence of successful unauthorized decrypts.
lee: should proxy return 403 or 503 for KMS AccessDenied? Keep 403 so callers see auth failure; add x-keystore-diagnostic header to aid automation.
own: agree. Also add an automated revert playbook: open revert PR and page infra-ops automatically when threshold crossed. Human approval still required.
maya: filing incident INC-2026-08133 and assigning @sam_infra for pipeline hardening and @lee for proxy resiliency.
oncall: closing thread, re-open if new signals.
